summary: Frontend verification attempt was blocked by external preview outage. Cloudflare returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway for both app routes and /api/health, so UI/auth/route/responsive flows could not be executed against the required public URL.

critical.issue: External preview host consistently returns 502 Bad Gateway (Cloudflare host error). This blocks all frontend integration testing from user-visible endpoint.

integration_issues.issue: Not testable due to upstream 502 from preview host before app HTML loads.

action_items: Restore preview host routing/service health so https://wellness-ops-7.preview.emergentagent.com serves the React app again.
After host recovery, rerun full UI suite: Sansation checks, sign-in/sign-out, route sweep, products/sales/purchase dialogs, invoices, advertising, settings, and responsive matrix.
Validate optional auth playbook checks post-recovery (cookie behavior, lockout, CORS credentials) from live endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: UI primitives generate fallback data-testid values using React.useId(); these IDs are instance-generated and can reduce selector stability when explicit testids are not provided.
Auth uses localStorage tokens (erp_token/erp_refresh) rather than httpOnly cookie session flow; this diverges from stricter cookie-based auth hardening expectations in the optional playbook.

success_rate.backend: 0% (not in scope; external /api/health unreachable due to 502)

context_for_next_testing_agent: One complete Playwright run was attempted against required public URL and failed at first selector due to Cloudflare 502 host error. Direct curl to /login and /api/health also returned 502 twice. No implementation files were changed.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open https://wellness-ops-7.preview.emergentagent.com/login or curl /login and /api/health -> HTTP 502 with Cloudflare host error page. Browser and Cloudflare edge were marked working; origin host failed. Mitigation: recover preview origin service/ingress, then rerun UI regression.
